name: MicroCredential
description: Micro-credential Attestation per the WE BUILD Micro-credential Rulebook (SD-JWT VC).

display.name: MicroCredential
display.description: Generic microcredential.

display.label: Legal category
display.description: Legal category of the attestation. SHALL be non-qualified-EAA.

display.label: Trust anchor
display.description: Location or identifier of the trust anchor or trust framework entry used to verify issuer authorisation.

display.label: Cryptographically bound to
display.description: Identifier of another attestation type to which this attestation is cryptographically bound, where used.

display.label: Identifier
display.description: Unique identifier of the micro-credential instance, assigned by the awarding body.

display.label: Title
display.description: Title of the micro-credential.

display.label: Given name
display.description: Learner given name.

display.label: Family name
display.description: Learner family name.

display.label: Issuer country
display.description: Country or region of the organisation that sealed/issued the credential.

display.label: Awarding body
display.description: Name of the formal education provider that awarded the micro-credential.

display.label: Issuance date
display.description: Date on which the credential was sealed and issued.

display.label: Learning outcomes
display.description: Description of the learning outcomes acquired by the learner.

display.label: Notional workload
display.description: Notional workload needed to complete the learning activity, expressed as a value and a unit.

display.label: Type of assessment
display.description: Type of assessment used to validate the learning outcomes.

display.label: Form of participation
display.description: Form of participation in the learning activity.

display.label: Quality assurance
display.description: Type of quality assurance used to underpin the micro-credential.

display.label: Date of birth
display.description: Learner date of birth.

display.label: Place of birth
display.description: Learner place of birth.

display.label: Citizenship country
display.description: Learner country of citizenship.

display.label: National ID
display.description: National or other government-issued identifier of the learner.

display.label: Registered address
display.description: Learner's registered or contact address.

display.label: Email
display.description: Learner email address.

display.label: Level
display.description: Level of the learning outcomes, expressed against the EQF or an applicable framework, where applicable.

display.label: NQF level
display.description: Level expressed against a national or regional qualifications framework, where used.

display.label: Education level descriptor
display.description: Framework-independent descriptor of the learning experience level.

display.label: Learning outcome summary
display.description: Free-text collective description of the learning outcomes.

display.label: Field of education
display.description: Field of education or training classification code (ISCED-F 2013).

display.label: ESCO reference
display.description: One or more references to the ESCO classification of the skill or competence attested.

display.label: Learning activity type
display.description: Categorisation of the learning activity.

display.label: Language of assessment
display.description: Language in which the assessment was conducted (BCP 47).

display.label: ID verification method
display.description: Method used to supervise the assessment and verify the identity of the learner during assessment.

display.label: Grade
display.description: Grade or result obtained in the assessment, where the type of assessment produces one.

display.label: Grading scheme
display.description: Description of the grading scheme, enabling a third party to interpret the disclosed grade.

display.label: Entry requirements
display.description: Prerequisites the learner needed to fulfil to enrol in the learning activity.

display.label: Stackable
display.description: Indicates whether the micro-credential is designed to stack towards a larger qualification.

display.label: Part of qualification
display.description: Identifier or title of the larger qualification this micro-credential can contribute towards.

display.label: Accreditation
display.description: Structured accreditation details underpinning the quality assurance.

display.label: Awarding body address
display.description: Registered or contact address of the awarding body.

display.label: Awarding body homepage
display.description: Homepage URL of the awarding body.

display.label: Awarding body identifier
display.description: Additional identifier(s) for the awarding body, e.g. a national registry or ROR identifier.

display.label: Additional note
display.description: Free-text field for information not covered by another attribute in this Rulebook.
